title: MIST: Multi-dimensional Implicit BiaS Evaluation of LLMs for Theory of Mind
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure faith/religion. It focused on implicit biases related to race, gender, and health within the framework of Theory of Mind (ToM) and the Stereotype Content Model (SCM).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
